searchText: I agree with many of the points that Alex raised about a light client supporting "attestations". As of now, there is definitely not enough details to define a feasible version. The classification by "functionality" is a method to think about light weight clients. Classifying light client in terms of what they could do forces us to be specific about what we mean by a light client. I responded to Alex's discussions on "light validator" on the ethresear.ch thread. I argued that there could be value in breaking that "uniformity" ideal. yeah i certainly hear what you are saying 🙂 the thought exercise is definitely valuable, if it that direction became more realistic i'd say our efforts are better spent making it easier to run a beacon node before we add an entirely new class of consensus actor.... my 2 wei

excerpts.content:
I agree with many of the points that Alex raised about a light client supporting "attestations". As of now, there is definitely not enough details to define a feasible version. The classification by "functionality" is a method to think about light weight clients. Classifying light client in terms of what they could do forces us to be specific about what we mean by a light client.

I responded to Alex's discussions on "light validator" on the ethresear.ch thread. I argued that there could be value in breaking that "uniformity" ideal.
